_about: PaperFeed config. Keys starting with _ are comments and are ignored.
_keyword_sets: One block per topic you follow. 'terms' are OR'ed together. A term containing [ ] is passed to PubMed as raw search syntax; anything else is searched as a quoted phrase in title/abstract.

keyword_sets.name: IDH1 glioblastoma
keyword_sets._min_score: 'glioblastoma' is broad, so require the match to be in the title (title_weight is 4). Papers that merely mention it in the abstract are hidden and reported, not forgotten.

_interval_days: Minimum days between digests. The scheduler wakes the script daily; it exits quietly until this many days have passed. Change this number to change your schedule.
_lookback_days: How far back each run searches. Keep comfortably larger than interval_days so nothing slips through a gap.
_max_per_set: Cap on papers fetched per keyword set per source. Stops the first run being enormous.
_contact_email: NCBI asks that automated tools identify themselves. Sent as a User-Agent header only.
_email: Set enabled to true once your digests look right. The password is NEVER stored here: set the environment variable named in password_env. For Gmail, use an app password, not your account password.
